Photograph of the white-border [[Dengar (Revised)]] card, published by [[Decipher]]. The photograph was published at the eBay image host; its photographer is unidentified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/rJYAAOSwe0Zcma1B/s-l500.webp complete obtained card photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 357 × 500-pixel obtained photograph is retained as the source. The entire obtained frame was used. It was proportionally downsampled with Pillow Lanczos resampling to 350 × 490 pixels and saved as RGB PNG without inherited metadata. No perspective correction, border painting, badge removal, replacement wording or reconstruction was applied. This is a photographic reproduction, not a facsimile. The photograph's acquisition date does not establish the card's first publication date.
